title: Platinum compounds enter cancer treatment
body: Cisplatin's anti-tumor activity is confirmed, laying the groundwork for platinum-based chemotherapy that remains first-line treatment today.

title: CA-125 is identified
body: The CA-125 antigen is discovered and soon becomes the standard blood biomarker for monitoring ovarian cancer, despite its known limitations.

title: BRCA1 is cloned
body: The BRCA1 gene is identified and linked to hereditary breast and ovarian cancer risk, followed by BRCA2 in 1995 — reshaping genetic counseling and screening.

title: TCGA publishes the ovarian cancer atlas
body: The Cancer Genome Atlas releases a comprehensive genomic analysis of high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma, becoming the foundational public dataset for ML research in the field.

title: PARP inhibitors are approved
body: Olaparib is approved for BRCA-mutated ovarian cancer, the first therapy to directly exploit a genetic vulnerability identified through molecular research.

title: The fallopian tube origin theory gains ground
body: Growing evidence suggests many high-grade serous cases originate in the fallopian tube rather than the ovary, reshaping prevention and early-detection research.
